long_biography.plain_text:
Andrew entered a family manufacturer rooted in woven laundry textiles and drove its defining diversification. In the 1970s, he moved the group into engineered needle-punch felts for industrial dust filtration, creating a global pollution-control materials business. A second push established BMP Engineering, which developed textile and polyurethane components for printing, automation, appliances, automotive applications and renewable energy.

The filtration division was sold to Lydall in 2014, but Andrew Industries retained its laundry-textiles and engineering businesses. Andrew continues as chairman and an active director of the family-owned group, whose production network spans Britain, North America, Mexico, China and Malaysia. His operating approach has centred on reinvestment in manufacturing equipment, product development and overseas capability rather than a single consumer brand.
